---
title: "Package a Versioned Release"
subtitle: "Separate curation from publication"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

Release packaging begins only after curated targets and disclosure rules are
approved. This page deliberately chooses no format, schema, version, or
destination yet.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Approve The Release Contract"}

A human owner must decide:

- release resources and their grain;
- public, restricted, or internal access classification;
- allowed identifiers, geographies, and temporal resolution;
- required data dictionaries and provenance metadata;
- validation standard and publication destination;
- semantic version and immutability policy.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Package Without Re-Cleaning"}

Future package targets should consume curated targets, attach reviewed schema
and provenance, write to a versioned directory under `data/processed`, and
refuse to overwrite a nonempty immutable release. Packaging must not contain a
second, hidden implementation of cleaning rules.

```r
# Human-owned placeholder; choose the release contract before implementation.
# release_package_validated_list <- { ... }
# release_files_published_paths <- { ... }
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Release Evidence"}

Future checks must validate the package schema, disclosure controls,
round-trip equality with curated targets, provenance, checksums, and a no-op
second targets run.

:::
